data.body: Root cause clarification: The fix is already present in skip-review-check.sh (worktree version, line 83-99: enforcement.strategy=ci exits 0 immediately). harvest-worktree.sh correctly delegates to skip-review-check.sh which handles CI enforcement. The original failure was due to the plugin cache (v1.16.11) having a stale skip-review-check.sh without the CI enforcement check. The worktree version is correct. Test 26 added to test-harvest-worktree.sh validates the correct behavior as a regression guard. Closing: fix already present in codebase, test now covers the behavior.
